INSERT INTO recon.scan_ports
                        (host_id, port, protocol, state, service, product, version)
                    SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
                        $1::uuid[],
                        $2::int[],
                        $3::text[],
                        $4::text[],
                        $5::text[],
                        $6::text[],
                        $7::text[]
                    )
